title: Polynomial of bounded degree
statement: A function $P:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ is a polynomial of degree at most $d$ if there are real coefficients indexed by subsets $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, all zero whenever $|S|>d$, such that at every $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, $P(x)$ is the sum over all such subsets of the coefficient for $S$ times the Boolean monomial indexed by $S$ evaluated at $x$.
